chart.realExplainer: Real value = nominal value adjusted for inflation. Shows how much purchasing power the money will have in today's prices.

footer.methodology: The calculation uses compound interest with monthly compounding: monthly rate rm = (1+r)^(1/12) − 1, balance B(n+1) = Bn · (1+rm) + contribution. Real value = nominal / (1+inflation)^years. The contribution is credited at the end of each month. Passive income = portfolio × annual withdrawal %. This calculator is not investment advice.
